title: How Montgomery Village Townhomes Load Lake Dust Into Air Ducts
headline: 1970s Stedwick closets, Whetstone paths, and why Lakeforest-era vents were never resized
description: Montgomery Village, MD is a 1970s planned community next to Gaithersburg. Learn why lake-side townhome ducts collect pollen and old-closet lint, and when to clean them from Bethesda.

sections.heading: Montgomery Village is not Gaithersburg. The closets are older.
paragraphs: Stedwick, Whetstone, East Village, the lakes, and the streets that used to orbit Lakeforest went up as a 1970s planned community next to Gaithersburg. The stock is townhomes and colonials from that build-out, plus later infill. Mechanical closets are tight. Dryer vents were run for machines that no longer exist. HOA paths keep lots leafy — and the returns keep pulling that leaf grit.
Lake-side humidity is the other half. Cool lower-level trunks sweat in Maryland summers. Pollen from the original tree plan sticks.

sections.heading: A 1970s dryer run is a fire and humidity problem
paragraphs: The original vent was sized for a smaller machine. Lint packs at elbows you cannot see without pulling the unit. Heat and moisture dump into a closet that already sits over sweating trunks. Registers look clean after you wipe them and gray again when the AC cycles.
If the lower level smells musty, start with [air duct cleaning in Montgomery Village, MD](/locations/montgomery-village).

sections.heading: Typical signs in a Montgomery Village townhome
listItems: Musty air from a lake-side lower level in July.
Leaf-season grit on supplies along Stedwick or Whetstone paths.
A dryer that needs two cycles in a 1970s closet.

sections.heading: Bethesda dispatch — not a Lakeforest mailbox
paragraphs: Montgomery Village is served from our [Bethesda](/locations/bethesda) office. Nearby [Gaithersburg](/locations/gaithersburg) and [Germantown](/locations/germantown) use the same crew. There is no village storefront.
Book on the [Montgomery Village location page](/locations/montgomery-village). Add [dryer vent cleaning](/dryer-vent-cleaning) for original closets.
listItems: Dehumidify lower levels in summer, especially on the lakes.
Change filters when HOA trees are dumping pollen.
Clean ducts every 3 to 5 years; clear 1970s dryer vents about once a year.

faq.q: Is Montgomery Village the same as Gaithersburg?
faq.a: No. It is a separate planned community with its own page. Gaithersburg is next door. Both dispatch from Bethesda.

faq.q: Why do 1970s Village townhomes still have dusty ducts?
faq.a: Original closets, lake humidity, and a tree plan that dumps pollen. Returns pull all of it. Filters do not empty the trunks.
